messages:
jamal: Heads-up — small docs tweak + README formatting fix. Release window is tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Do we treat this as a patch bump or can we skip bumping and rely on buildmeta?
maria: Docs-only typically doesn't need a semver increment if it's truly docs, but our releasebot defaults to creating a patch tag unless it sees the 'docs-only' label.
alex: We chatted about this before — provenance matters for auditing. I prefer a patch bump for any change that goes through the release pipeline so changelogs are easy to trace.
lina: From oncall perspective, less churn in minor/night windows is better. If we can avoid an extra patch release, 👍. But only if releasebot won't break other automation.
jamal: The PR already has label: docs. But deploy-bot still queued it as a patch in the staging lane. Not sure why.
deploy-bot: automated check: releasebot heuristic = "patch_for_any_merge". To opt out add label: no-release-bump or use /release skip-bump.
maria: Ah — we added 'docs' not 'no-release-bump'. Two different signals. Should we standardize to one label?
kevin: Quick thought — what about using build metadata instead of bumping (e.g., v1.4.3+docs202403)? Keeps semver stable, still records the change. Some downstream consumers parse buildmeta, some don't.
alex: Buildmeta is less visible in many UIs and is semver-compliant but can be ignored by release pipelines that key off major.minor.patch. Also rollout tooling uses exact patch numbers for pinning.
jamal: Right. Our Dedicated infra pinning scripts expect a numeric patch to decide rollbacks. If we use buildmeta only, pinning will treat it as same version and won't trigger.
lina: That's a concern. If an infra pin equals v1.4.3 and we ship v1.4.3+docs, rollback tooling might not distinguish — could be dangerous.
maria: So options: 1) Always patch bump for any merged change that hits the release window. 2) Use a special flag to let truly non-deployable changes skip bump (requires standard label + gating). 3) Use patch bump but auto-mark non-functional in changelog.
kevin: Option 2 is appealing but requires releasebot changes. Do we have time to patch releasebot before tomorrow?
jamal: No. Minimal change plan: for tonight, we add label no-release-bump to this PR and manually run the skip command to avoid the patch. For longer term, we need an RFC to standardize signals.
alex: Manual skip for now is fine. Please document the manual step in the PR template so others don't forget.
deploy-bot: To manually skip: run command in PR thread: `/release skip-bump --reason "docs-only"` — CI will log: 
```
releasebot: skipping patch bump, creating release note entry under buildmeta (internal)
```
Also: if manual skip is used during change window, ops must manually verify canary pin behavior.
maria: Can we tweak the release notes script to still write a tiny entry in changelog so auditing is preserved even if bump skipped?
kevin: Yes — we can write a changelog fragment keyed to the PR number without changing semver. Lightweight change, I can file it after lunch.
lina: Reminder: if anyone opts to skip bump, include the rollback playbook snippet in the PR: what to do if we need to force a rollback (manual pin to last numeric patch + trigger redeploy).
jamal: I'll update the PR with /release skip-bump and add the rollback snippet. Also adding a note to the release window checklist: confirm releasebot label mapping.
alex: Long term RFC idea: prefer numeric patch bumps for any change that touches release artifacts. Allow skip only for pure docs that don't change artifacts, gated by both label + reviewer checkbox.
maria: Agreed. I'll draft the RFC — include: label semantics, deploy-bot commands, changelog behavior, and interaction with pinning/rollback automation.
kevin: I'll prototype the small changelog fragment change to keep auditability if skip is used.
jamal: Thanks. For tonight: I ran `/release skip-bump` and left a comment. Can someone confirm deploy-bot recognized it?
deploy-bot: command accepted. Pipeline note: releasebot will NOT increment patch for this merge. Manual canary validation required.
lina: I'll run the canary validation checklist during the window if it ends up in staging.
jamal: Great — closing this thread unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
kevin: Filing a follow-up PR for RFC and changelog tweak.
maria: Thanks everyone.
